audio_description:
Green-lit corridors of the Lunar Base flash past.
The ring station, wrapped in red energy, erupts into fiery explosions.
It tears apart, debris scattering into the void.

context.scene_title: The Lunar Base is destroyed — the Esthar space station breaks apart in the Lunar Cry (Disc 3).
